_comment: Art. 77(2) access lattice for the battery passport. Verified verbatim against the consolidated OJ text CELEX_02023R1542-20250731 on 2026-09-19. SCOPE: batteries only — ESPR Art. 11(b) defers access rights to each product group's delegated act under Art. 4, and none is adopted for the other product groups. Do not generalise this table.

audiences.label: Anyone
audiences.sub: No credential, no login, no fee

audiences.label: Repairer, recycler, second-life operator
audiences.sub: On a credential proving a legitimate interest

audiences.label: Notified body, market surveillance, the Commission
audiences.sub: Standing conferred by a member state

points.title: Point 1: public information about the battery model
points.note: Material composition, carbon footprint, recycled content, rated capacity, expected lifetime, declaration of conformity, waste management information.

points.title: Point 2: model information for readers with a legitimate interest, and the Commission
points.note: Detailed composition, dismantling instructions and the safety measures dismantling requires.

points.title: Point 3: evidence of conformity
points.note: "Results of test reports proving compliance with the requirements laid down in this Regulation".

points.title: Point 4: the individual battery's own history
points.note: State of health, battery status, and "data resulting from its use, including the number of charging and discharging cycles and negative events, such as accidents, as well as periodically recorded information on the operating environmental conditions, including temperature, and on the state of charge".
